item.title: Bi-Weekly Music Chart Highlights: Top 20 Tracks Across 16 genres Mar 10, 2025 edition
item.description: This week's music charts see new entries from Royal & The Serpent, King Princess, and Five Finger Death Punch, alongside shifts in hip-hop, R&B, and dance pop rankings. Twice and Megan Thee Stallion debut in multiple categories, while Kendrick Lamar strengthens his presence. Meanwhile, established names like Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, and Rema hold firm. Across 16 charts, genre influences blend, with Arcane Season 2 tracks making an impact and modern dancehall gaining traction.
